item.title: How to Set Up Blog With Hugo and Github Pages
item.description:
Outline

  1. Motivation — why I wanted to start a blog
  2. Results - what I built & tech stack
  3. Implementation - Conceptual guide
  4. Reflection - Implementation Insights & Lessons I learend
  5. References

Motivation

“The best way to learn is to learn in public.”

I came across ’learning in public’ mindset with the blog post by Shawn Wang. The idea stronly resonated with me, after spending many years attending lectures, consuming online tutorials, and reading research papers without redistributing the knowledge somehow.
